checker.kind: AI page inspection (producer-side), not an independent human review

method: Official govinfo FR issue PDF re-downloaded once to scratch (not committed) from the URL recorded in jobs/source-ladder/output/SOURCES.jsonl; its sha256 equals the held witness hash recorded in the source records and dossiers; the named PDF pages were rendered with pdftoppm and inspected as images with the Read tool; the operative sentences and dates were compared by eye with the extracted text spans the dossiers use.
original_pages_confirmed_scope: The official pages/images named in pdf_pages_checked were inspected; this supports original_pages_confirmed: true for these sources only for the verified sentences listed. It decides no legal status.
guardrails: No codebook, status, census or certified-count change (certified stays 0). AI statuses remain hypotheses. Pending owner rulings (report-deadline, transcription-as-copy, EO 14052 strike-and-reinsert) are not decided here; any target needing one stays BLOCKED.
